senses.gloss: m. pl. (a corrupt. of παρατάξις, v. Ducange Gloss. Gr. 1531) soldiers, police.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94:9">Gen. R. s. 94</cite>, end <he>שדר פ׳ בתריה</he> he (the royal officer) sent the police after him to arrest him.—V. <cite ref="Q01594"><he>פַּרְדַּשְׁכָּא</he></cite>.
